label.en: Industrial Digitalization Engineer · Machine Vision / Smart Manufacturing
label.zh: 工业数字化工程师 · 机器视觉 / 智能制造

highlights.en: Led a production-line real-time visual inspection system: **DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT** multi-stream video inference with **32 concurrent feeds**, covering helmet / reflective-vest / safety-belt / smoking defects and anomalies; consecutive-frame confirmation, alert cooldown and evidence frames deliver stable event alerts (Webhook + RTSP preview).
highlights.zh: 主导产线级实时视觉质检系统：**DeepStream + YOLO + TensorRT** 多路视频推理，**32 路并发**，覆盖安全帽 / 反光衣 / 安全带 / 吸烟等缺陷与异常检测；配套连续帧确认、告警冷却与证据帧机制，稳定输出事件告警（Webhook + RTSP 预览流）。

highlights.en: Optimized and engineered inference for production: **two-stage detection** with dynamic batching, frame sampling and **TensorRT FP16**; **PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT** automated build and deployment, containerized with Docker and hosted on a **Linux GPU server (4× NVIDIA L20)**.
highlights.zh: 面向产线落地做推理优化与工程化：**两阶段检测架构** + 动态 Batch、抽帧与 **TensorRT FP16**；**PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT** 自动构建部署，Docker 容器化，服务托管于 **Linux GPU 服务器（4× NVIDIA L20）**。

highlights.en: Completed camera calibration with pixel-to-physical coordinate mapping and built in-house data-collection tools closing the collect → label → train → deploy loop; also prototyped an enterprise document RAG QA system (BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen).
highlights.zh: 完成相机标定与像素—物理坐标映射，开发内部数据采集工具，打通“采集—标注—训练—上线”数据闭环；并搭建企业文档 RAG 问答原型（BGE-M3 + Qdrant + Qwen）。

highlights.en: Contributed to the Global EV Data Initiative: multi-source collection, cleaning and validation of charging-pile sensor-network data, producing standardized datasets and a device distribution / status monitoring dashboard.
highlights.zh: 参与 Global EV Data Initiative：负责充电桩传感网络数据的**多源采集、清洗与校核**，产出标准化数据集，并搭建设备分布与状态监控看板。

summary.zh: MSc, Land Surveying & Geo-Informatics（传感与空间数据方向）· **Distinction** · GPA **3.9 / 4.3**
